title: Sampling Simultaneous Edge-Colorings
summary: We study the sampling problem for simultaneous edge colorings. Given a pair of graphs $G_1=(V,E_1)$ and $G_2=(V,E_2)$ which are on the same vertex set $V$, a simultaneous edge coloring is an edge coloring of $G_1\cup G_2$ so that each of the individual graphs is properly colored. When each of $G_1$ and $G_2$ are of maximum degree $Δ$, then it is conjectured that $Δ+2$ colors suffice, and recent work asymptotically establishes the conjecture.
